captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional B&B. Not a client project.

A lot of small accommodation sites still use an enquiry form: name, email, dates, guests, then wait to hear back about availability. Someone planning a weekend away just wants to know if Saturday is free.

So we put a live booking card under the photo: pick the dates, see if the room is free, book it. The rooms sit right below with photos.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional country B&B’s homepage.

The old version has a lovely photo of the cottage, then an enquiry form. Six fields, and a promise to get back to you about availability. Someone planning a weekend away has to ask, wait and hope.

The new one puts a booking card under the photo. Pick the dates, see straight away whether the room is free, and book it. Photos of each room sit just below.

Not a client project. If your accommodation site still runs on an enquiry form, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
